title: Blood Forge Requisition: 7,000 cr from the War Citadel: the darksteel collected at Blood Forge, delivered to the Anvil Arsenal
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY; rules F34 tier 2 for a pilot at Krynn, F37). The War Citadel's board (get_missions of a Voidborn-born trader docked there, 18:39 UTC) offers Blood Forge Requisition [blood_forge_requisition]: collect the darksteel shipment at Blood Forge, deliver 10 Darksteel Plating to the Anvil Arsenal; 7,000 cr, +30 trading, +25 navigation, +40 piloting XP; chain next solarian_composites. The goods are handed out at the pickup (the objective names a collection; not yet seen: this test reads it). Road: Krynn -> Blood Forge 1 jump -> Iron Reach -> The Anvil 2 -> Krynn 1, all Crimson policed space (scripts/map.py route), no pirate in 108 to 212 readings of each (data/intel/sightings.jsonl). Darksteel plating is size 2: 20 of the hold, empty_hold asked. A test: three ships at once (F37: a board mission, independent results), Voidborn- and Nebula-born alike: the boards differ by birth. 2026-11-23 19:24 UTC (Mercury): the test held: 3 of 3 runs paid 7,000 cr (Blood Forge Requisition handed in, +6,891 cr net each, 12.6 minutes; runs.jsonl 19:01 UTC), the darksteel handed out at the pickup. max_ships 3 -> 36: every trader docked at the War Citadel; a pilot whose board does not offer it ends at the first stop.
